compiled_state.title: [UPDATE] Update runner smoke tests to assert schema-correction integration path in runner.py
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1 (partial — runner integration side): When this story is complete, schema-invalid findings trigger exactly one correction dispatch via dispatch_schema_correction() before _write_output(); max_attempts=0 short-circuits to synthetic-error path

## TDD Requirement
This is an UPDATE test task. Modify tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py to add assertions about the new schema-correction call path BEFORE runner.py is modified (Task 5). The updated tests must fail (RED) against the current runner.py because dispatch_schema_correction has not been called yet.

Test approach:
- Given: runner.py's main() is called with a mock that makes validate-review-output.sh return exit 1 (schema fail)
- When: runner.main() executes
- Then: assert dispatch_schema_correction() is called exactly once (or zero times when max_attempts=0)

Specific assertions to add to test_runner_smoke.py:
1. test_runner_calls_schema_correction_on_schema_fail: When S-A's validation step signals schema-fail exit code, assert dispatch_schema_correction is called before _write_output
2. test_runner_schema_correction_max_attempts_zero_skips_dispatch: When review.schema_correction_max_attempts=0, assert dispatch_schema_correction is NOT called (synthetic error appended directly)
3. test_runner_schema_correction_result_written: When dispatch_schema_correction returns corrected findings, assert _write_output is called with the corrected findings (not the original schema-invalid ones)

Note: These tests mock dispatch_schema_correction itself — they test runner.py's orchestration of the correction call, not the correction logic internals (that's covered by test_dispatch_schema_correction.py).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py --collect-only -q 2>&1 | grep "test session starts"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py
- [ ] test_runner_calls_schema_correction_on_schema_fail exists in test_runner_smoke.py
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -q "def test_runner_calls_schema_correction_on_schema_fail" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py
- [ ] test_runner_schema_correction_max_attempts_zero_skips_dispatch exists
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -q "def test_runner_schema_correction_max_attempts_zero_skips_dispatch" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py
- [ ] New tests FAIL (RED) against current runner.py (before Task 5 integration)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py::test_runner_calls_schema_correction_on_schema_fail 2>&1 | grep -E "FAILED|AttributeError" | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 < 1)}'
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_runner_calls_schema_correction_on_schema_fail] for plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
  Verify: grep '\[test_runner_calls_schema_correction_on_schema_fail\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
